title: Chargers rule out LB Daiyan Henley, list WR Ladd McConkey as questionable

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Chargers rule out LB Daiyan Henley, list WR Ladd McConkey as questionable
sources.description: Chargers linebacker Daiyan Henley missed practice this week with knee soreness, and the team has ruled him out for Sunday's game against the Jets.
